Hi Emma — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO. Short answer: we can accommodate a reverse-charge reissue, but we need to validate your VAT ID and a signed self-billing/consent form before issuing a credit note + reissued invoice net of VAT.

To proceed please:
- Attach the signed self-billing agreement (signed by an authorized signatory at DutchVend).
- Attach an official VAT certificate or a screenshot/export of the VIES lookup showing NL123456789B01 as valid.
- Confirm the legal entity name and company registration (as it should appear on the invoice).

Operational steps from our side once we have docs:
1) Tax will validate the VAT ID via VIES and internal checks (Neha).
2) We will raise a credit note for invoice #4530 (Laura will action).
3) Finance will reissue invoice #4532 (net of VAT) with a reverse-charge note referencing Article 194 and the buyer VAT ID.
4) Collections will put a temporary hold if you ask; otherwise please await the reissued invoice before making payment.

If you prefer us to proceed immediately with the hold, say the word and I will park the payment. Otherwise we'll validate and reissue within 48-72 business hours after receiving the signed docs.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Please confirm ETA; Emma asked for the reissue before they process payment. I'm happy to loop in Legal if you need the signed self-billing stored in contract records.
